description: The elastic band of these bun hair pieces is designed to fit the average hair volume for most people. If it is too loose or too tight for you, you can fix it with U-pins, or adjust the elastic.
How to adjust elastic ?
◆ Find the knot of the elastic and untie the knot.
◆ Hold both ends of the elastic, adjust to the proper length and make a new knot.
◆ We suggest adjusting it to the length that you can wear tightly in 2 rounds.
Unlike the human hair, the synthetic hair fibers may get tangled after 4 or 6 wears because of static.
How to solve tangled ?
◆ Soak it in warm water with conditioner for 5 minutes. Gently press with your hand to clean, do not twist and squeeze.
◆ Gently remove any tangles with your fingers from the ends and work your way up, cut the tangled hair if necessary.
◆ First dry with a towel after washing, to avoid vigorously rubbing. Use the hair dryer for less than 30 seconds.
◆ When 80% dry after washing, apply some hair care essential oil, and then allow it air dry naturally.
Note

- This tousled updo may not be in the perfect look when you receive due to the possible squeezing of the packaging and transportation process, which may require you to take a few seconds to take care of it, and its look in the images will be presented.
- These messy hair buns are hand-made, normally some hair fibers may shed when your first use. Thank you for your understanding.
Care Tips

Dust and moisture in the air may hurt the synthetic hair fibers. To prevent it, you can get a spray bottle and put some conditioner in it, then fill it up with water. Spray it in the scrunchies. It will make the scrunchies hair not very dry and prevent getting tangled in some extent.

Step 1: Soak cotton pad with acetone. Step 2: Wrap around each nail with tin foil leave for approx. 10 minutes, check if ready if not leave a few minutes more. Step 3: Use an orange stick or a cuticle pushier to remove softened gel.
Peel off easily?

1. Remember to cap the nail edge when we apply the color gel. 2. Remove the cuticle, trim the edge, polish your nails and make sure they are dry and clean. 3. We can not have the polish attached to skin or cuticle otherwise it will be easy to peel off. 4. Do not apply overmuch base coat or top coat and, the thinner, the better, or it will get the gel shrunk and peeled off.
Not dry?
Please check the wattage of your lamp. Are you only curing for 30 seconds? We suggest: Base coat cured for 30 secs. Gel polish each coat - 60 secs. Top coat - 60 secs. Wipe with alcohol cotton ball.
Too Thick?
Applying every thin coat is the key , make sure the brush don't have too much on it before starting the strokes.

description: How to use a depilatory roller wax cartridge?

1. Before use, make sure the skin is absolutely clean using a Pre Wax Treatment Spray. 2. Insert the wax cartridge into the wax heater machine. 3. Plug the cord into the wax machine then connect the main power and turn on the power. 4. Heat the wax cartridge for 30min upwards depending on the amount of product in the wax cartridge, when ready then begin to use. 5. Always Test the wax cartridge by rolling the wax cartridge on a piece of depilatory wax strip paper before beginning and then test on a small area to make sure you have no skin reactions to the wax cartridge product. Make sure that the temperature is suitable for the wax treatment, if the wax is too hot, wait for a little while then begin the treatment. Make sure the skin is taut when applying and removing the depilatory wax strip paper to avoid bruising. (Bruising of the skin can occur should the wax not be melted well enough hence not able to be removed properly and when the skin is not kept taut when removing the wax. Burns of the skin can occur should the wax be too hot.Test before use on a small area) 6. Roll the wax cartridge in the direction that the hair grows. 7. Use the Wax Strip Paper Pre Cut 100 or Depilatory Wax Paper Roll 100yard on the treatment area, use your hand to press down the hair growth. 8. Make sure the skin is taut then Pull off the wax strip in the opposite direction of the hair growth. 9. After hair removal, use After-Waxing wipes to clean. 10. Clean your wax machine heater and wax roller cartridge head using the Wax Cleaner.

Coco Sulfate - Is a cleaning and foaming material that is derived from 100% natural coconut oil. Coco sulfate provides excellent lather, thickening and conditioning properties to the hand soap.
Sorbitol - Is a natural compound that is found in fruits and plants. Sorbitol provides moisturizing properties to the hand soap.

Citric Acid - Occurs naturally in citrus fruits. Citric acid reduces the pH level of the soap, allowing the natural preservative to be more effective. Citric acid also binds to the metals in water, improving the effectiveness of the hand soap.

Silica - Is a very fine powder that has a high surface area. Silica is used to absorb the liquid fragrance, and also helps the powder flow well when compressing into tablets.

beard wash is a specially formulated mild wash carefully blended with carrier and essential oils which provide conditioning, promote beard and skin health, as well as a wonderful scent. Hair goes gray due to the accumulation of hydrogen peroxide in hair follicles, causing oxidation of melanin. A hair follicle that no longer contains as much melanin, will become a more transparent color (gray, silver or white) as it grows.
For Grey hair stops this process, removes accumulated oxygen from oxidized colorless melanin with the enzyme glucuronate reductase, which binds with silver nitrate and prevents further oxidation

How to use: Using the spatula provided, spread the cream evenly on the skin areas to be treated. Do not rub in. Leave on the skin for 5 minutes. Use the spatula to remove the cream from a small area of the skin. If the hair goes off easily, use the spatula to remove the rest of the cream, moving against the direction of hair growth. If the hair is still not easily removed, leave the cream on the skin, but not for longer than 10 minutes from start of application. Duration of application depends on the thickness of hair. Remains of the cream can be removed with a wet sponge. Next, wash the skin with warm water (do not use soap) and dry. The formula should not be used for face hair removal. Before the first application of the formula it is necessary to do an allergic test: apply the cream on a small area of the skin, and rinse it after a few minutes. Unless an allergic reaction develops in the application place within 24 hours, you may start depilation. If at any point your skin starts to burn, remove the cream and rinse the skin with warm water. Gently budge the wig without any rub.

Wig nourishment
Use hair balsam - rinse onto hair or soak the wet wig into cool water for 10 minutes. Then wash out.

Wig drying
Put the soaking wig in a dry towel and gently drain, but not wring.
Wet wig can be left to dry completely on a towel in room temperature. Do not use hairdryers and other heat devices.
Wig holding and protection
Hold the wig far from open fire, hot water and air, sun light, heat devices.

EYELINER 101
Applying eyeliner is a tricky task, but getting a straight line is worth your time.
Stand 6 inches away from a mirror and tilt your chin up, so that when you look down your nose into the mirror, you can see your entire eyelid.
Dab concealer or dust translucent powder on your upper lids. Blend well with a sponge or lightly pat with a fingertip to cover veins and prevent creasing.
Before applying liner, determine your eye shape. If eyes are close-set or round, line only the outer corners. Otherwise, rim the entire upper lid.
Soften the pencil top by rolling it between your fingers.

Gently pull your eyelid taut at an upward angle. Beginning at the inner corner, draw small, connected dashes along the top lashes. Be sure to stay close to the roots so there is no skin visible between the lashes and the liner. To make eyes look bigger, extend the liner slightly beyond the outer corners.
Brush a matching powder shadow on top of the liner to keep it from rubbing off.
Soften the line with a sponge tip or cotton swab by rubbing it slightly up and out at the corners.
Use a cotton swab to fix mistakes. For larger messes, dip it in makeup remover.
